+Show Configuration
+------------------
+
+To print the loaded application's configuration as JSON, use the
+:func:`config <cli.config_command>` command. The values of any key containing
+``SECRET``, ``PASSWORD``, ``TOKEN``, or ``KEY`` are masked as ``"***"``. ::
+
+    $ flask config
+    {
+      "DEBUG": false,
+      "ENV": "production",
+      "SECRET_KEY": "***",
+      ...
+    }
+

+@click.command("config", short_help="Show the app configuration.")
+@with_appcontext
+def config_command() -> None:
+    """Show the app configuration as JSON."""
+    import json
+
+    config_items = {}
+
+    for key, value in sorted(current_app.config.items()):
+        if any(token in key.upper() for token in ("SECRET", "PASSWORD", "TOKEN", "KEY")):
+            config_items[key] = "***"
+        else:
+            config_items[key] = value
+
+    try:
+        click.echo(current_app.json.dumps(config_items, indent=2))
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        click.echo(json.dumps(config_items, indent=2, default=str))
+
